name: Graph Theory
description: Graphs as mathematical objects: paths, connectivity, trees, matchings, flows, colouring, planarity and networks.

nodes.name: Graph basics
nodes.desc: Vertices, edges, degrees, the handshake lemma, subgraphs and directed versus undirected graphs.

nodes.name: Representations
nodes.desc: Adjacency matrices, adjacency lists and incidence matrices and their trade-offs.

nodes.name: Special graphs
nodes.desc: Complete, bipartite, regular, cycle, path, wheel and hypercube graphs.

nodes.name: Isomorphism
nodes.desc: When two graphs are the same, graph invariants and automorphisms.

nodes.name: Walks & paths
nodes.desc: Walks, trails, paths, cycles, distance and diameter.

nodes.name: Connectivity
nodes.desc: Components, cut vertices, bridges, k-connectivity and Menger's theorem.

nodes.name: Euler & Hamilton
nodes.desc: Eulerian circuits, Hamiltonian cycles and conditions such as Dirac's and Ore's.

nodes.name: BFS & DFS
nodes.desc: Breadth-first and depth-first search and what their trees reveal about structure.

nodes.name: Directed graphs
nodes.desc: Strong connectivity, condensation, DAGs and topological orderings.

nodes.name: Trees
nodes.desc: Equivalent characterisations of trees, rooted trees and Cayley's formula.

nodes.name: Spanning trees
nodes.desc: Minimum spanning trees and counting spanning trees with the matrix-tree theorem.

nodes.name: Matchings
nodes.desc: Matchings and covers, Hall's marriage theorem and König's theorem.

nodes.name: Network flows
nodes.desc: Max-flow min-cut, augmenting paths and applications to matching.

nodes.name: Graph colouring
nodes.desc: Chromatic number, greedy colouring, Brooks' theorem and edge colouring.

nodes.name: Planar graphs
nodes.desc: Euler's formula, Kuratowski's theorem and the four colour theorem.

nodes.name: Graph toolkit
nodes.desc: Implement a graph library with traversal, flow and colouring algorithms and tests.

nodes.name: Spectral graphs
nodes.desc: Adjacency and Laplacian eigenvalues and what they say about a graph.

nodes.name: Random graphs
nodes.desc: Erdos-Renyi graphs, thresholds and the giant component.

nodes.name: Ramsey & extremal
nodes.desc: Ramsey numbers, Turan's theorem and extremal questions.

nodes.name: Network analysis
nodes.desc: Centrality, PageRank and community detection in real networks.

nodes.name: Network study
nodes.desc: Analyse a real social or transport network and compare it with random models.
